why: plate_page_point's cases, held by the engine (engine/facade/tests/plate_page_point.rs) and the web (features/plates/platePosition.test.ts). The georeference is KRFD ILS RWY 07's (d-TPP 2610; its GeoPDF viewport is services/planner/tests_wingtip/test_plates.py's KRFD_I07), the affine as wingtip.plates.Georeference fits it with pyproj (PROJ). Its page is 396 by 612 points (5.5 by 8.5 inches). The plan view here is the viewport's own box, an inset cut from its bottom left. Where the FAA's points (GPTS) go: at LPTS's fractions of the viewport's box, (9.18 + 0.1 x 369, 2.628 + 0.9 x 588.744) = (46.08, 532.4976) points, so x = 46.08 / 396 and y = 1 - 532.4976 / 612. A true track turns on the page by the projection's convergence, gamma = n (lambda - lambda0) (Snyder, USGS PP 1395, eq. 14-4), n = 0.694913 for parallels 46.667 and 41.333 N (eq. 15-8): page rotation = track - gamma, to a hundredth of a degree.
